evidence: Reads an entry from the global context table, selects a helper path based on the input context flag, obtains a value through the attribute-record pointer helper and selector 7, then compares the incoming scalar float (v0) against 0.5 and stores a 32-bit boolean to the caller output pointer (decompiled/main/main_0123.c:50520-50545, 50547-50550). No indexed callers were available; the label describes the observable threshold result without assigning a game-domain meaning.

Returns immediately for a null input. Otherwise reads the 32-bit value at input+0x26, masks it to six bits, and proceeds only when it equals 0x1d. The guarded path loads the remap table entry at the global context base+0x420 and calls update_attribute_remap_record_for_three_entries, then performs follow-up checks and may pass the input record to another helper (decompiled/main/main_0123.c:36480-36511). No indexed caller establishes a more specific role.

Queries context selector 0x13 and returns the error value 0xfffffffe when its low byte equals 8. Otherwise it validates the second argument is at most 1, requires a later context result to equal 2, initializes a mapping table for indices 0..29, and returns the table value for the derived index when that index is at most 0x1d; failed checks return 0xfffffffe (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:49786-49812, 49816-49819). The table domain is unknown, so the label describes the visible gating and lookup.

Checks attribute-context status 21, optionally reads a signed byte from the global entry and routes it through a helper, initializes temporary context data using fixed sizes/selectors, calls follow-up helpers, and stores 1 at input+0x1c (decompiled/main/main_0121.c:24389-24417). Its indexed caller reads input+0x1c immediately afterward and branches on the value (decompiled/main/main_0121.c:20407-20411). The exact context data domain is unresolved.

Initializes a local record pointer, follows the global entry at 0x7002290000+0xaa8, and proceeds through the follow-up helpers only when the global_context_record_has_acceptable_status predicate succeeds; otherwise it returns without that processing path (decompiled/main/main_0081.c:26333-26346). Its only indexed caller tail-calls this routine (decompiled/main/main_0081.c:26320-26324); no higher-level domain meaning is available.
